kv_cache: fp8 e4m3, one fp32 scale per (position, kv head)

prompt_activations.nvfp4_layers: nvfp4 with the checkpoint's static input_global_scale and e4m3 16-element block scales

drafter.source: model_mtp.safetensors (bundled MTP layer, used as released)
drafter.encoding: NVFP4 re-encoding (per-tensor global scale, E4M3 16-element block scales) of the BF16 weights for drafting; FP8 per-row copies of fc and the key/value rows for the prompt pass
drafter.head: NVFP4 copy of the FP8 lm_head (full vocabulary)

gemm_selection: recorded table: index into cuBLASLt's heuristic list per (format, M, K, padded T, ldd), measured once on this GPU (tools/tune_gemms.py) and shipped as gemm_table.txt; first heuristic for shapes not in the table
chat_template: chat_template.jinja as shipped (thinking enabled, default reasoning effort)
chat_decoding: sampled speculative: drafts accepted with probability p(d) under the filtered (temperature, top-k, top-p) target distribution; a rejected column is resampled without d
draft_policy: per round K in 1..7 maximizing (1 + p + ... + p^K) / (1 + 0.07 K); p = decayed accepted/attempted drafts of the request (prior 0.8 over 4 trials)
prompt_attention: FP8 E4M3 Q K^T on cached key codes (per-row query scale, per-key scale) and FP8 E4M3 P V on cached value codes (probabilities times per-key value scale over a running maximum, in E4M3); 64-key cp.async double-buffered tiles
prompt_scan: sequential gated-delta scan, 16-token shared-memory tiles, 3 value-column slices per head (48 + 40 + 40), fast exp decay
decode_attention: fp8-kv-attention entry decode (BF16 Q K^T and P V over dequantized FP8 cache)
